title: Timbaland's AI artist TaTa Taktumi signs with Ne-Yo's Pacific Music Group (Music Business Worldwide)
notes: MBW (domain authority), Mandy Dalugdug, 2026-03-25. PMG (Ne-Yo, Sonu Nigam, MC Jin, Jonathan Serbin; Hong Kong) signs TaTa as exclusive Asia manager + global label; 'part human' AI artist with real Filipino-heritage performer behind persona; debut 'Glitch x Pulse' Oct 2025; Stage Zero independent of Suno.
